gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-kosugi-maru: Kosugi Maru reads like glowing neon tubing, rounded and clean, with stroke ends held far apart. Cherry Swash sits above it, wide-mouthed and commanding, so the two feel like a loud sign beside a gentle whisper.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-kumbh-sans: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe, and its diagonals carry as much heft as its verticals. Kumbh Sans follows in sans-serif form, terminals cut short of the bowl, so the page gets a strong voice and then a steady, professional one.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-lato: Cherry Swash has a distinctive horseshoe c and strokes as taut as a drawn string. And Lato, a plain sans with wide s curves barely curled in, sits lower in contrast, so enlarging the body would flatten that gap.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-libre-franklin: A horseshoe-shaped c and marker-like, constant-width lines make Cherry Swash instantly recognizable, with diagonals as heavy as its verticals. Libre Franklin, clean and professional, quietly takes over below.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-livvic: Approachable is the first thing Livvic says, and it says it plainly. Cherry Swash earns its keep big and brief, with its horseshoe c and commanding diagonals, while Livvic, a plain sans with generous c openings and no stress in its curves, carries the rest.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-lunasima: Distinctive from the first glance, Cherry Swash draws a w with no thick or thin strokes. Lunasima, clean sans-serif with c tips that never creep toward touching, stays low in contrast, so shrinking the heading would lose the whole point.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-lxgw-marker-gothi: Cherry Swash opens its c like a horseshoe, with strokes steady as a drawn string. Against it, LXGW Marker Gothic offers a sans with bowls that shift weight gently, and that quiet softness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-m-plus-1: M PLUS 1 gives every e and a a big open eye, drawn with the flat line of a fineliner. Cherry Swash, with its horseshoe c and heavy diagonals, brings the swagger, and that gap between loud and level is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-m-plus-1p: Joins that never thin out where strokes meet mark Cherry Swash. It brings the horseshoe c and bold, commanding presence, while M PLUS 1p, a plain sans open at every curve end, simply keeps the text clear.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 reads friendly and businesslike, with a gaping c and one fixed nib width. Cherry Swash, horseshoe c and heavy diagonals, is the loud half, so a heading set small would waste it next to this plain sans.
